text:
Camila Reyes: Kicking off a quick review of the case study outline template + assigning owners for the first drafts. Dropping links below — please add comments directly in Drive by EOD tomorrow so we can start interviews next week.

Camila Reyes: Template (web story + PDF 1-pager structure): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RW-template-case-study-outline
Camila Reyes: Draft outlines:
- Northwind (Dedicated): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RW-northwind-outline-v0
- Helios (Private/VPC): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RW-helios-outline-v0
- Atlas (enterprise docs/RAG): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RW-atlas-outline-v0

Camila Reyes: What I need from this thread:
1) Any edits to the template headings/order (esp. Results + disclaimer placement)
2) Writer + interviewer assignments for Northwind/Helios/Atlas
3) Who from SE will own diagram + technical validation for each

Soojin Lee: +1. When you review, please sanity check against the messaging pillars: pick 2–3 max per story so we don’t turn these into feature dumps.

Ethan Wallace: Read through template — looks solid. Two quick tweaks:
- In “Why Redwood”, can we force a “Claim” + “Proof” sub-bullet? (Otherwise drafts turn into vibes.)
- In “Results”, I’d move “how measured” *above* the numbers/ranges so Legal doesn’t have to keep asking for it later.

Camila Reyes: Love both. I’ll update the template doc to make Claim/Proof explicit.

Markus Klein: On Implementation section: can we add a line that we should mention *routing/fallback policy* only if we can describe it concretely (e.g., “fallback to compatible model variant when capacity constrained”)? We’ve had drafts that sound like magic.

Soojin Lee: Agree. Also watch superlatives (“industry-leading”) — keep to measured outcomes.

Rachel Kim: From CS angle: can we add a small callout near the top: “Customer-approved scope (logo/metrics/quotes)” so we don’t accidentally write past what the account is comfortable with?

Ethan Wallace: +1. Maybe a simple checkbox block:
- Logo: yes/no
- Named attribution: yes/no
- Metrics: exact / ranges / none
- Review window: X biz days

Camila Reyes: Adding that to the header block. :thumbsup:

Tyler Benson: For assignments: if we’re keeping the template consistent, I can also create a lightweight intake tracker field list (owner, stage, next action, review window) and pin it in #marketing once we agree.

Camila Reyes: Please do — but first let’s lock owners here.

Camila Reyes: Proposed staffing (open to edits):
- Northwind: Writer = Ethan, Interviewer = Camila, SE/diagram = Markus + Simran
- Helios: Writer = Ethan (or Soojin if you want to own the compliance language), Interviewer = Miguel + Rachel, SE/diagram = Simran
- Atlas: Writer = Ethan, Interviewer = Avery (since they have the relationship), SE/diagram = Markus

Avery Johnson: I can do Atlas interview. Only constraint: I want us to be careful on competitor mentions. They’ve been explicit they don’t want us naming the prior provider publicly.

Soojin Lee: For Helios, I’d like to own final narrative pass + compliance-safe wording, but Ethan can draft first pass if that helps speed.

Ethan Wallace: Works for me. If Soojin owns final pass on Helios, I’ll draft the skeleton and leave placeholders where Legal language needs to be tight.

Simran Kaur: I can take Helios diagram + technical review. For Northwind, I can draft the diagram but would like Markus to sign off on the Dedicated sizing language (we should keep it high-level anyway).

Markus Klein: Yep. For Northwind: I’ll do technical validation + final diagram review. For Atlas: I’ll validate the eval / migration claims, but we’ll need to cite internal proof links.

Rachel Kim: Helios interview: I’ll join Miguel, and I’ll also prep a “what we can/can’t say” list before the call. They have a pretty strict approval chain.

Miguel Santos: Confirmed. I’ll schedule Helios for a 45 min story interview + 15 min approval process walkthrough. I’ll put proposed times in the thread once I have them.

Camila Reyes: Great. Assignments locked unless someone objects:
- Northwind: Ethan (writer), Camila (interviewer), Markus+Simran (SE + diagram)
- Helios: Ethan (draft writer) + Soojin (narrative/compliance pass), Miguel+Rachel (interview), Simran (SE + diagram)
- Atlas: Ethan (writer), Avery (interview), Markus (SE validation)

Camila Reyes: Template edits I’m making now based on feedback:
- Add “Customer-approved scope” checkbox block to header
- Add Claim/Proof formatting in “Why Redwood”
- Move “how measured” note to the top of Results section
- Add a caution line in Implementation re: routing/fallback only if we can describe it concretely

Soojin Lee: Can we also add a reminder that “Results highlights” at top should be max 3 bullets and must match what’s later in Results (no new claims)?

Ethan Wallace: Yes please. Also: for the PDF 1-pager, we should force a single “Results callout” box with the disclaimer right under it.

Camila Reyes: Done — adding both.

Tyler Benson: Once template is updated, I’ll mirror the headings into the intake tracker so we can report “drafted / tech validated / legal / customer review / published” cleanly.

Markus Klein: One more nit: In diagram guidance, add “no internal hostnames / no account IDs / no ticket numbers.” Keeps us from back-and-forth later.

Camila Reyes: Added.

Avery Johnson: Atlas interview Qs I plan to cover:
- baseline latency/cost targets
- what forced the switch (operational pain / reliability)
- how they validated output quality during migration
If anyone has must-ask items, drop them here.

Soojin Lee: Ask what they’d tell a peer evaluating inference vendors. That tends to produce the best quotable lines.

Rachel Kim: + ask their preferred cadence for reference calls (so we don’t overload them). Even if Atlas isn’t public yet, we can set expectations.

Camila Reyes: Perfect. Next steps:
- Everyone: leave template comments in Drive by tomorrow EOD
- Interviewers: schedule by end of week
- SE: start diagram drafts after first interview (no earlier)

Camila Reyes: I’ll post the updated template link in this thread once revisions are in.

Ethan Wallace: :white_check_mark: I’ll start Northwind draft outline edits today and tag you, Camila, with questions.

Simran Kaur: :thumbsup: I’ll prep diagram shells (blank with labels) so we can fill in fast post-interview.

Camila Reyes: Updated template link (v1): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RW-case-study-template-v1 — incorporated all changes above. Please use this structure going forward.
